Сервер MOOD MUD¶

MUD (Multi-User Dungeon) game server module.

This module implements a multiplayer text-based adventure game server. Players can move around a 10x10 grid, encounter monsters, fight them, and communicate with other players.

The server uses asyncio for handling multiple client connections and implements game mechanics including monster movement, combat, and player interactions.

Базовые классы: object

Main game class representing a player’s game session.

This class manages player state, including position, weapons, and interactions with monsters. It also handles special monster types like jgsbat.

async mood.server.__main__.main()[исходный код]¶

Start the MUD game server.

This function initializes the server and starts the monster movement task before beginning to accept client connections.

async mood.server.__main__.move_random_monster()[исходный код]¶

Periodically move random monsters around the game field.

This function runs every 30 seconds and: 1. Selects a random monster 2. Attempts to move it in a random direction 3. Broadcasts movement messages 4. Handles player encounters
